config.label: Your three
config.description: Your three.ws bearer credential — an API key (sk_live_… / sk_test_…) or OAuth access token. Every copy-trade subscription, intent, and fee is scoped to the account it identifies. Required for all tools except a leader's public aggregate earnings. Mint one at https://three.ws/settings/api-keys. Treat like cash.

config.label: Base URL of the three
config.description: Base URL of the three.ws API that serves the copy-trading endpoints. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.
